name: Drum Bus, Punch
description: 4 to 1 with the slowest attack and the fastest release: each hit's front passes before it takes hold, and it lets go before the next, so the drums come out harder.

name: Drum Bus, Tight
description: 4 to 1 at 3 ms and 0.3 s, with the lows out of the sidechain: the kit is held in one place, the room is brought up a little, and the kick does not pump the cymbals.

name: Drum Room, Breathing
description: 10 to 1 with the detector behind the gain element, as the console's own is, which takes hold sooner the higher the ratio, at 1 ms and the fastest release: a room microphone pumps and breathes between the hits.

name: Ducked by the Kick
description: 4 to 1, the fastest attack, and 0.3 s of release, for a sidechain: set it to the kick's track, and a bass or a pad is pushed down each time the kick hits and swells back between.

name: Master, Touch
description: 2 to 1, the slowest attack, the automatic release, and a high threshold: it works only on the loudest moments, a dB at the most. The last device on the master.

name: Mix, Glue
description: 2 to 1 with the slowest attack and the automatic release: the whole mix is held together by a dB or two, the fronts of the hits pass, and a loud passage is let go slowly. Lower the threshold until the meter moves 1 to 3 dB.

name: Mix, Low End Free
description: The glue with a high-pass of 120 Hz in the sidechain, so the kick and the bass do not pull the rest of the mix down with them, and a faster attack of 10 ms.

name: Parallel Smash
description: 10 to 1 with both switches at their fastest and the threshold low, everything flattened, and the mix at 40 %: the crushed drums under the drums as they were, in one device.
